# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

We want a technically rigorous, welcoming project. Be respectful, assume good faith while asking for evidence, critique ideas rather than people, and protect private or security-sensitive information.

Examples of unacceptable behavior include harassment, discriminatory language, doxxing, publishing private work data, or using project spaces to disclose an unpatched vulnerability.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainers through the repository's private contact or security-advisory channel. Maintainers may edit, hide, or remove contributions and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation when needed to protect the community.

This policy applies in repository discussions, pull requests, issue trackers, and project events.
